claim: Kaspa's builders never stopped, the tools came online in 2026 (Toccata made Layer 1 programmable) and the crowd has not arrived yet: that gap is exactly where Mike wants to be standing.
why_this_claim: It is the video's own spine compressed to one idea: conviction that has nothing to do with price, one dated receipt as proof that the building shipped, and the inspiring line that turns the quiet numbers into the opportunity. It needs none of the other 8 minutes: no chart, no Solana parallel, no L2 names, no live-drift figure. Every word is Mike's recorded take, and the devices on screen (NOTHING TO DO WITH THE PRICE, 5 YEARS OF BUILDING, BULLISH ON / KASPA, LAYER 1 IS PROGRAMMABLE, THE TOOLS CAME FIRST / THE CROWD HAS NOT ARRIVED YET) read the argument even muted.

The Solana parallel (C22 monthly chart, C25, the parallel-not-prediction cards): the persona rule needs the full 'parallel, never a prediction' framing and the chart's legend states to be honest; 30 s cannot hold it, and 'what a written off network can do' cut loose from its guard would read as a Kaspa prediction.

The TOO LATE? / EARLY. text wall: a perfect visual kicker but a 3.5 s silent card freeze (12 percent of the short with no VO, and its EARLY cash-register is not in the spine audio); cutting inside or at the edge of the freeze is forbidden.
